title: Canonical Trajectory Payload (P3)
description: Backend-independent trajectory pose payload stored in CAS. Contains ordered pose nodes with optional per-pose covariance. Every trajectory backend (ORB-SLAM, KISS-ICP, COLMAP, future AI systems) produces this document through its adapter. The trajectory metadata (scene_id, session_id, kind, status, aggregate uncertainty) lives in the MetadataDb row, not this payload.

trajectory_id.description: Instance-scoped UUIDv4 identity matching the MetadataDb trajectory row (D-TRJ-02).

nodes.description: Ordered pose nodes (D-TRJ-07). Ordered by sequence_index; gaps are allowed for dropped frames.

PoseNode.description: A single pose in the trajectory (D-TRJ-07…D-TRJ-09). Position and rotation are T_trajectory_camera (D-TRJ-08): the transform mapping a point from the camera/body frame into the trajectory's local coordinate frame. Quaternion order: (x, y, z, w) scalar-last per ADR-007.

frame_id.description: UUID referencing a Frame in the import model (D-TRJ-10, bridge reference).

timestamp_ns.description: Exposure timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch. Must match the referenced Frame.timestamp_ns.

sequence_index.description: Monotonically increasing ordinal; gaps are allowed for dropped frames (D-TRJ-07).

rotation_xyzw.description: Unit quaternion in (x, y, z, w) scalar-last order (ADR-007).

covariance_position.description: Optional 3×3 position covariance, upper triangle flattened row-major (xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz). Translation-then-rotation ordering (ADR-007). When absent or zero-filled, uncertainty is unknown (D-TRJ-09).

covariance_rotation.description: Optional 3×3 rotation covariance, upper triangle flattened row-major. Same ordering as covariance_position.
